scenes.history:
>SHOOT THE PIRATE
Trembling, you fire the heavy arquebus. You hear its loud report over the
roaring wind, yet the dark figure still approaches. The gun falls from your
nerveless hands.
   "You won't kill me," he says, stepping over the weapon. "Not when I am
the only protection you have from Jean Lafond."
   Chestnut hair, tousled by the wind, frames the tanned oval of his face.
Lips curving, his eyes rake over your inadequately dressed body, the damp
chemise clinging to your legs and heaving bosom, your gleaming hair. You
are intensely aware of the strength of his hard seaworn body, of the deep
sea blue of his eyes. And then his mouth is on yours, lips parted,
demanding, and you arch into his kiss...
   He presses you against him, head bent. "But who, my dear," he whispers
into your hair, "will protect you from me?"

PLUNDERED HEARTS

LATE ONE SPRING NIGHT IN THE WEST INDIES...

   A crash overhead! Pirates are boarding the Lafond Deux! The first mate
hurries you into Captain Davis's cabin.
   "Good, you brought the girl," Davis smirks. "She'll keep the pirates
busy. She was only a tool of Lafond's, anyway. Let me just find that cof--"
A man on deck screams in agony and Davis starts. "Let's go." The captain
thrusts you on the bed and walks out, locking the door.
   His laugh echoes. "Best get comfortable, girl. You're likely to be there
for the rest of your life."

Cabin, on the bed
   You are in an officer's cabin, lit by the firelight glowing through a
porthole. A door is to starboard. Except for the built-in bed, the room
seems to have been emptied thoroughly, if hurriedly.

>

>> STAND UP
You get out of the bed.

>
>> INVENTORY
You have your reticule (hanging from your wrist). It seems that your
reticule contains smelling salts and a banknote. You are wearing your kid
slippers, a linen chemise and a cotton frock.

>
>> EXAMINE SMELLING SALTS
You always carry your smelling salts, for emergencies. There is a small tag
on one side of them.
   "The Falcon! The Falcon conquers!" yells someone.

>
>> READ TAG
It says, "For cases of vapors, hysteria or collapse, revive persons with
the smelling salts."
   You recognize a voice from far away, "Don't take that! Look in the cabin
at the stern -- you'll find some fun there!" It sounds like Davis.

>
>> EXAMINE BANKNOTE
This is the banknote that came in your game package.
   Suddenly, the ship lurches to one side, throwing you off balance. A
coffer slides from under the bed and bumps against your foot.

>
fixed_recent_comments: The room seems emptied thoroughly, if hurriedly, despite the immediate violence that has just occurred. This sudden lack of personal belongings emphasizes the protagonist's immediate reduction to a captive object.

scenes.history:
>> OPEN CURTAIN
You pull the cloth aside momentarily. Behind it, a large cupboard mostly
blocks the doorway.

>
>> EXAMINE CUPBOARD
You can see only the back of the large cupboard. You might be able to
squeeze past it.

>
>> EXAMINE TABLE
You have no need for that, milady.

>
>> EXAMINE BED
Someone appears to have tumbled out of it in a hurry.

>
>> WAIT
Time passes...
   You hear the large cupboard scrape, and turn to see Captain Jamison.
"Hello! I came down to give you this -- my allotment from the coffer." He
nods at the box in his arms.
   Jamison starts to pin a jewelled brooch on your clothes, but, "Devil
take it, the clasp is broken. I'll have it repaired." He folds the pretty
thing into your hand. "And I meant to reassure you that if the men suddenly
abandon ship, they are off to help me. Rodney will stay behind with you."
He drops the coffer on the floor, smiling in farewell, and walks swiftly
away.

>
fixed_recent_comments: The speaker lingers on the player’s beauty and takes their hand, creating an intimate moment. Yet, the immediate practical advice is to rely on Cookie, who is noted to be quite deaf.
Jamison's hatred is not abstract but rooted in a specific, violent memory of piracy and loss. The past tragedy has transformed a simple rivalry into a deeply personal, enduring vendetta.

scenes.history:
>> EXAMINE BROOCH
All diamonds winking fire, tears of sapphire and crushed rubies in an oval
setting, it is a pity that the clasp of the jewelled brooch has broken. The
gold pin at the back swings about uselessly.

>
>> OPEN COFFER
Opening the coffer reveals an invitation.

>
>> TAKE INVITATION
Taken.

>
>> READ INVITATION
The invitation is addressed to "Davis":

       In Honor of Jean Lafond,
         recently proclaimed
       Governor of St. Sinistra
        A Dance at his Mansion
      Ananas Road, St. Sinistra
Formal Dress and Invitation Required.

   A ball! You haven't been to a ball in months!

>
>> NORTH
The large cupboard is not flush against the doorsill. You squeeze through
the opening between cupboard and wall.

Landing
   You are on the landing of a steep stairway heading up and down. A large
cupboard against the aft wall blocks the doorway to the captain's quarters.

>
>> DOWN
Aft Hold
   This is a gloomy, damp area at the bottom of the Helena Louise. To the
fore there seems to be a little more light, or you can climb up some steep
stairs.

>
fixed_recent_comments: Jamison's hatred is not abstract but rooted in a specific, violent memory of piracy and loss. The past tragedy has transformed a simple rivalry into a deeply personal, enduring vendetta.
Jamison attempts to affix the jeweled brooch, only to find the clasp is broken. He then folds the piece into the player’s hand, transforming a display of adornment into a simple, held object.

scenes.history:
>> NORTH
Crew's Quarters
   The crew sleeps, in shifts, in this cramped space under the forecastle.
A breeze blows in on a moonbeam through a grate in the ceiling. A low
doorsill is abaft.
   This area must also serve as sickroom. Strewn about the floor are
various powders and spills of malodorous potions. In one corner, a large
blood stain indicates an amputation; in another is the smear of a leech,
dropped off a bloodletting.
   A small bottle has been dropped nearby.
   A chipped piece of mirror sits propped on a shoulder-high timber.

>
>> TAKE BOTTLE
Taken.
   "I gotta let Lafond know 'e's comin'." Crulley stands on deck above,
talking to himself, his voice floating down through a grate in the ceiling.
"First, I do in the mates aboard-ship, with this and t'other mischief," he
grunts, and you hear a snapping noise, like a taut rope being cut. "Now to
warn the boss and collect me pay. Off I go, har." He dives into the sea.

>
fixed_recent_comments: The invitation speaks of a formal dance in St. Sinistra, a world of polished ceremony. This promise of high society is starkly contrasted by the gloomy, damp confines of the ship's hold.
The supplies—casks of rum, flour, and gunpowder—are stacked behind a high fence. Yet, the fire is burning in the ammunition cage, dangerously close to these vital stores.

scenes.history:
>> NORTH
Main Deck
   It is a deceptively quiet evening on the ship, the pirates singing low
shanties as they repair cannon, twist ropes and sharpen daggers. The
mainmast casts an inky shadow over the canvas screening the hatch. A
tangled mass of rigging hangs down from the mast, like many rope ladders
woven together.
   The reefs are definitely getting larger.
   Two large barrels stand near the stair to the foredeck.

>
>> NORTH
Forecastle
   Higher than all but the poop deck, this end of the ship commands a good
view of the island; the "crow's nest," swinging above in the heights of the
foremast, would command a better. A tangled mass of rigging hangs down from
the mast, like many rope ladders woven together.
   Imbedded in the deck is a grated air hole to the crew's quarters below.
You can go aft, or forward through a break in the ubiquitous railing.
   Odors of old grease and char waft from a little shack perched behind the
mast.
   The reefs are definitely getting larger.
   You can see a mooring winch here.

>
fixed_recent_comments: The ladder slams into the stern, driving all the air out of you. This sudden, forceful impact follows the earlier description of clinging tenuously to the slimy rung.
The cannons line the deck, aimed at the open sea and the island, yet no torches are lit. This heavy military readiness exists under the quiet, pervasive glow of the moon.

scenes.history:
>> TAKE DAGGER
Taken.

>
>> EAST
Forecastle
   You can see a mooring winch here.

>
>> SOUTH
Main Deck

>
>> SOUTH
Quarterdeck
   Abaft the wheel sits a large pyramid of casks, held in place by a heavy
rope.
   Cannon line the deck, aimed at open sea and the island.

>
>> LOOK IN CASK
You can see a slab of pork.

>
>> ENTER CASK
You crawl into the cask, feeling a slab of something stuck on the bottom.
From this close, you can see the line is getting frayed where it rubs
against the cask.

>
>> TAKE PORK
You peel it off the cask.

>
>> PUT ALL IN RETICULE EXCEPT DAGGER
slab of pork: Done.
shirt: You'll have to remove the shirt first.
breeches: You'll have to remove the breeches first.
your kid slippers: You'll have to remove your kid slippers first.
linen chemise: You'll have to remove the linen chemise first.

>
fixed_recent_comments: The large pyramid of casks sits precariously, held only by a heavy rope against the deck. This organized stack of supplies feels both necessary and temporary, a fragile monument to the ship's current state.
The galley man offers a casual greeting and a quick reassurance about the Captain's safety. He then specifies that he and his peg are assigned to guard the Captain's young lady.

scenes.history:
>> EXAMINE PORTRAIT
The portrait seems familiar, and you realize it is exactly the picture on
the front of the banknote Lafond sent you, same clothes, same surroundings,
same pose.

>
>> EXAMINE BOOKSHELVES
Most of the books appear unread, their pages uncut, the spines not yet
creased. All except one, "Treatise of Power" by Sir Michael Villiers.

>
>> EXAMINE GLOBE
The massive wooden globe, painted in greens and blues and white, describes
the world as presently known.

>
>> TAKE HAT
As you lift the hat from its knob on the wall, a low vibration tingles up
your legs from the floor.

>
>> SOUTH
For safety's sake, you leave the hat on its knob. Best not to show that
you've been wandering.

East Hallway
   The carpeted hallway turns from west to north here, extending into the
east wing. A long table blocks the way south.
   A black-garbed butler marches up to you, "It was made clear at the
whippings that villagers are not admitted in this house." He grasps you by
the scruff of the neck and propels you headfirst out the front door.

Main Entrance
   The front door stands open to the south, light splayed out onto a drive
stretching north into the jungle. A path leads around the western wing of
the house; jutting out from the east wing is a tall hedge.

>
fixed_recent_comments: Nicholas frames his departure not as a rejection, but as a necessary act of self-preservation. His statement that he must leave lest he lose his soul in her elevates his restraint into a dramatic, almost spiritual, act of control.

The massive wooden globe squats in the corner of the library, suggesting a contained world of knowledge. This object stands in stark contrast to the open, wild landscape glimpsed just outside the window.

scenes.history:
>> GIVE INVITATION
[to the butler]
The butler takes the invitation. "Enjoy the dance, Miss Davis."

>
>> SOUTH
The sea of spectators parts to admit you, murmuring approval.

Ballroom
   Lafond's party is well attended: you can hardly move for the crush.
However, the room is oddly silent, no talk interrupting the musical efforts
of the musicians to the west. Despite the heat, no one ventures south to
the veranda, nor through the opening east. The foyer is north of you.
   Captain Jamison moves up to you, saying, "May I have this dance?" He
doesn't await an answer, sweeping you out onto the dance floor.

>
>> DANCE
You pace out the steps.
   "I haven't found your father. We've long suspected a passage under the
library, but I cannot find an entrance," says Jamison.
   The steps of the dance separate you a moment, as you twirl around and
curtsey to another dancer. You glide back into the captain's arms.

>
fixed_recent_comments: The Parlour is furnished with exotic elements and features mounted duelling pistols. Yet, the inability to reach them is immediately followed by the social commentary that ladies do not carry pistols.

The chandelier is held above the dance floor by a rope and pulley system. This functional mechanism allows the servants to manage the light, introducing a practical, mechanical element into the grand spectacle.

scenes.history:
>> THROW PORK AT CROCODILE
The crocodile snaps its jaws shut as the slab of pork disappears into its
maw.

>
>> WAIT
Time passes...
   With an inaudible creak, the crocodile's mouth opens again.

>
>> WAIT
Time passes...
   Without warning, the crocodile relaxes, eyes closed, asleep.

>
>> SOUTH
You edge past the reptile.

Dungeon
   You sense, rather than see, the rusty skeletons of old cages and torture
devices that line the walls of this cavernous room. One flaming torch, high
on a wall, casts mad licks of light into the darkness. Passages lead north
and west. Set deep in the rocky floor is a closed trapdoor.
   A pair of manacles hangs from iron chains attached high on the wall.

>
>> WEST
Corner
   This short passage turns from east to north to stop abruptly at an iron
door.

>
>> UNLOCK DOOR
[with the large key]
Unlocked.

>
>> OPEN DOOR
Opened.

>
fixed_recent_comments: The gasps of air forced through the crack in the seaward wall are distinct from the general drafts elsewhere. This suggests the room is not merely exposed to the sea, but is actively drawing air from a specific, unseen source.
The crocodile rests half-submerged in the pool formed by the dripping walls. Its baleful gaze, coupled with wide-open jaws, suggests a predatory alertness despite its current stillness.

scenes.history:
>> POUR WINE INTO GREEN GOBLET
You fill the green goblet with wine.
   "In private, call me Jean, or whatever endearment you choose, once I
have approved it." Lafond is looking into the wardrobe.

>
>> SQUEEZE BOTTLE INTO GREEN GOBLET
You squeeze three colorless drops into the green goblet. You sense Lafond
hesitate, then continue primping.
   The butler enters, laying a silver tray of cold chicken on the table.
"The kitchen wench has gone, your grace. I took the liberty of fetching
these myself." He bows and leaves the room.
   "Sprinkle some spices on the fowl, ma petite," Lafond says, donning a
long brocade robe, his back to you. "They are hot, but delicious."

>
>> POUR WINE INTO BLUE GOBLET
You fill the blue goblet with wine.
   "Tsk. The cook has gone too far. She shall be 'leaving us' tomorrow."
Lafond adjusts the lace at his neck.

>
>> WAIT
Time passes...
   Lafond strolls to the table smiling slyly. "Which glass was mine? I seem
to have forgotten." He points at the green goblet and smiles in a way that
does not grant you confidence. "Is this it?"

>
fixed_recent_comments: The dancers quickly resume their banal conversations after the commotion involving Captain Jamison. This immediate return to chatter seems to absorb the violence into the background noise of the party.
Lafond treats the violent intrusion of Jamison and his men with casual indifference. He merely dismisses the fight as an annoyance before returning to his wine and changing clothes.

scenes.history:
>> TAKE PISTOL
Taken.
   Lafond immediately takes the advantage, forcing Nicholas in a retreat
towards the foaming surf. But Nicholas fights hard, jaw set, ignoring his
wounds. Lafond finally loses his smile.
   Behind the duellists, far away atop the cliff, you notice Crulley madly
reloading the pistol.

>
>> LOAD PISTOL
You pour a lumpy stream of gunpowder mixture into the barrel of the pistol
tamping it as best you can.
   Suddenly the force of the duel turns, Nicholas advancing against
Lafond's retreat. Their blades silently flash in the moonlight. Lafond is
pressed back into the shadow of the cliff, sweat beading on his forehead.
Abruptly, Jamison leaps forward, metal scrapes, and his rapier licks neatly
into Lafond's ribs, like a snake slipping into its burrow. The body of the
governor of St. Sinistra convulses, as in amazement, then sags dead on the
sword.
   Nicholas removes a gold ring from the dead man's finger, throwing his
own cheap copy into the surf.
   Far above him, Crulley moves down the stairs.

>
fixed_recent_comments: Lafond's pronouncement of death, framed as a moral judgment against "cowards," is immediately undercut by the practical mechanics of the duel. His rhetorical flourish transitions instantly into the cold, focused aim of the pistol leveled at Jamison.

Nicholas's acceptance of the duel is immediately conditioned by the freedom of his people. This transforms the confrontation from a simple matter of personal honor into a high-stakes political negotiation.

fragments.verbatim: I had written a really off-the-wall, bizarre little game
I was interested in in writing romance. I thought a romance might be kind of fun and different.
It's where does the world that you've invented break down
it made a difference in their lives and they remembered it
So I wonder if I really do want to write the novel or if I just want to keep dreaming about writing the novel.
We weren't doing just games. We were doing experiences, environments, and they were more like books.
